name: mcp.build
description: Catalog of hosted, open-source MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers for AI agents. Set up an MCP endpoint once and your agent can use them all.

agents.name: send-email
agents.description: Send emails from natural language prompts. No rigid schema — just tell your agent what to send and it figures out the rest.
agents.example_prompt: send email to javier@hal9.ai with text hello!

agents.name: run-python
agents.description: Run Python from natural language prompts, with optional PyPI package install. Ask it to install an orbital-mechanics library and compute a transfer to Mars — it writes and runs the code.
agents.example_prompt: install a package that calculates space orbits and compute the Hohmann transfer time from Earth to Mars and back, departing 2026-09-08
